# Legacy golden fixtures — reference `main@5d571a0`

These `.golden` files are the byte-exact ESC/POS output produced by the
**reference implementation in `main` at commit `5d571a0`** (function
`escpos.ParseXML`). They were not generated by the candidate implementation.

The `.xml` inputs are committed alongside them so the comparison is
reproducible. Regeneration must be done from a checkout of `main@5d571a0`, not
from the candidate branch; otherwise the test would compare the implementation
against itself.

Coverage: 9 fixtures — image heights below, on, and across the 2048-row legacy
slice boundary (255/256 and 2047/2048/2049), a three-slice 4097-row image,
non-byte-aligned widths (12 and 100 dots at 385 rows), and a mixed ticket with
text, feed, image and cut.

Generator used on 16/11/2026 (Go 1.26.10, linux/arm64):

```
git worktree add --detach /tmp/main-5d571a0 5d571a0
# cmd/goldengen calls escpos.ParseXML on each .xml and writes the .golden file
go run ./cmd/goldengen <xml-dir> <golden-dir>
```

Public key/credential material is not part of these fixtures.
